title: Claude Usage mod.json
description: What Herdr reads from Claude Usage's mod.json, and the settings it takes.

title.description: The mod's name, as Herdr shows it.

place.description: Where Herdr first docks the mod. "none": only where a layout or another mod puts it.

focusable.description: Lets pane.go give a shown copy the keyboard.

settings.description: Your changes. A setting left out uses its default.

mode.title: Display
mode.description: Where the telemetry shows: "panel" draws it in this mod's panel; "terminal" runs it as a TUI in a terminal pane, opened by the toolbar button or claude-usage.open.

every.title: Refresh
every.description: How often the usage endpoint is read while the panel or the terminal shows it. Anything under 30s counts as 30s.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model whose weekly limit the third card shows, by the name Claude gives it.

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: "neon": cyan and magenta on near black, whatever the theme; "theme": the same roles in Herdr's theme colours (the terminal's own colours in the TUI).

place.title: Terminal place
place.description: Where terminal mode opens the TUI: a split "right" or "down" of the focused pane, or its own "tab".
